name: Contrast Canvas
problem: Testing WCAG accessibility contrast ratios for complex UI components like gradients, text over images, and multi-state buttons is tedious with standard single-color pickers.
pain: Designers and developers often skip rigorous accessibility checks or fail compliance because current tools only support flat color-to-color comparison, leading to late-stage design refactoring or non-compliant releases.
solution: A local-first visual canvas where users can paste mockups, apply dynamic CSS gradients, overlay text elements, and instantly view a live, multi-point WCAG AA/AAA contrast map showing exactly which pixels fail contrast requirements.
verification: Load a mock background image, place text on top, and verify the calculated relative luminance and WCAG rating update in real-time using pure client-side mathematical algorithms.
major_features: Interactive canvas with drag-and-drop text overlays
Real-time relative luminance mapping for gradients and images
Instant WCAG AA/AAA compliance scoring and color suggestions
